comment: Hardware-support files added by repack-runtime.py --additions DIR. DIR mirrors these paths; each file must match its SHA256. Files marked "location": "drive" go into mt7668-wifi.tar.gz, which the installer copies to the console drive, instead of the initramfs, so the boot loader's contiguous initramfs block stays the 1.0 size.

lib/firmware/mrvl/sd8897_uapsta.bin.source: linux-firmware mrvl/sd8897_uapsta.bin W15.68.19.17 (Marvell 88W8897 Wi-Fi/Bluetooth on Slim and CUH-12xx, LICENCE.Marvell, redistributable)

lib/modules/6.15.4-androidtv-ps4-aeolia/.source: kernel/baikal/psx_mts_net.c (linux-psx Baikal Ethernet), built against the Baikal kernel

MT7668 Wi-Fi driver from the ps4-linux tree (drivers/net/wireless/mediatek/mt76x8), built as a module for 6.15.4-androidtv-ps4-aeolia with kernel/mt7668-proc-copy-bound.patch and kernel/mt7668-netns-ok.patch, debug symbols stripped
